name: Tidy folder
author: Luna examples
description: Knowledge about naming and organising files, and a workflow that reads a folder and reports what is in it.

skills.name: Naming files
skills.description: How this person likes files named.
skills.instructions: When you create or rename a file, use lower case with hyphens, no spaces, and put the date first as YYYY-MM-DD when the file is dated. Never invent an extension the contents do not match. If a name already exists, say so instead of overwriting it.

workflows.name: Survey this folder
workflows.description: Lists the granted folder and writes one paragraph about what it holds.
